parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of wood, forming the front movable panel of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the storage compartments inside the cabinet by opening and closing.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or swings on hinges attached to the cabinet frame, enabling opening and closing motion.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet frame made of wood, forming the structural body that supports the door and internal compartments.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and houses the storage compartments, supporting the door and top surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.
